channel.title: Blockfront
channel.description: Blockfront reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, DeFi protocols, exchanges, regulation, security incidents, funding rounds and network upgrades.

item.title: xStocks tops $1 billion in assets under management
item.description: Payward says xStocks crossed $1 billion in AUM on Oct. 27, with more than 1,500 tokenized assets spanning global markets and expanding onchain access.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150-millisecond finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with validator-to-validator voting designed to cut transaction finality from 12.8 seconds to about 150 milliseconds.

item.title: Omnichain apps move tokens and instructions across blockchains
item.description: Omnichain systems pass tokens or instructions between blockchains, but each transfer depends on verification, destination execution and the security of its route.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin rewards open to crypto exchanges
item.description: The OCC’s final GENIUS Act rule leaves exchanges room to pass stablecoin earnings to customers as rewards, while issuers remain barred from paying holders interest.

item.title: OCC leaves crypto exchange stablecoin rewards in play
item.description: The OCC finalized stablecoin rules that bar issuer-paid interest but leave exchange rewards to case-by-case review, keeping a contested yield model available.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms transaction finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing its consensus system and targeting faster transaction finality, while users can keep using their wallets and apps as before.

item.title: Why an Ethereum Bridge Deposit Can Run Out of Gas
item.description: A bridge deposit needs enough ETH to cover its transfer and source-chain gas; token approvals and failed transactions can add costs before funds arrive.

item.title: OCC rule leaves crypto exchanges able to offer stablecoin rewards
item.description: The OCC's GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying holders directly, while exchanges may offer rewards case by case under the new framework.

item.title: Why Cross-Chain Transfer Limits Change
item.description: A bridge limit can shift as route capacity refills or settings change; check the token, chain pair and transfer status before deciding what to do next.

item.title: What to check before a tron swap for stablecoins
item.description: A TRON stablecoin swap trades one token for another through a contract; check the network, quoted output, liquidity, fees and token approval before signing.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin rewards possible under GENIUS Act
item.description: The OCC's GENIUS Act rule leaves exchange rewards possible while barring stablecoin issuers from paying holders yield solely for holding their coins.

item.title: Claim a Mantle Bridge withdrawal on Ethereum
item.description: A Mantle withdrawal needs a separate Ethereum claim after the bridge marks it ready; keep ETH in the claiming wallet to pay the transaction fee.

item.title: Check a contract wallet’s swap order signature
item.description: A contract wallet’s swap signature is checked against the exact order digest through ERC-1271; verify the wallet, chain, order fields and returned magic value.

item.title: OCC rule leaves crypto platform stablecoin rewards in play
item.description: The OCC’s final GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying yield but leaves platform rewards to case-by-case review when it takes effect in 2027.

item.title: Budget funding before holding Byreal Perps
item.description: Before opening a Byreal Perps position, budget against its full notional, expected funding, round-trip fees and a price-move reserve; leverage only sets initial margin.

item.title: fermi swap: four checks before trading on Ethereum
item.description: Check the Ethereum network, token addresses, minimum received and approval scope before signing a Fermi Swap trade; the quote is not the final fill.

item.title: BaseSwap: When to Swap Tokens and When to Add Liquidity
item.description: A swap exchanges one token for another; a liquidity pool deposit supports future trades and may earn fees, with different costs and risks for each choice.

item.title: Mesh and Visa link wallet balances to 175 million merchants
item.description: Mesh will let participating wallet users pay online and in stores from crypto or stablecoin balances through Visa, with rollout details pending and no cash-out first.

item.title: Manta bridge transfers: why they wait and which route fits
item.description: A Manta bridge transfer can wait on wallet confirmation, cross-chain processing or a withdrawal step; check its stage before choosing a faster route.

item.title: Across users can skip repeat token approvals with a standing allowance
item.description: Across users can skip repeat approvals when a token allowance still covers the next bridge; changing the origin token, chain or spender can require a new one.
